stem: Alaska is a part of which of the following countries?
expl: Alaska is a province of United State of America situated in the northwest extremity. The United State purchased Alaska from the Russian Empire on March 30, 1867. Significantly, the treaty was signed by President Andrew Johnson on May 28, 1867 and Alaska was formally transferred to the US on 18 Oct. 1867.

stem: Which of the following cities is the seat of Parliament of South Africa?
expl: The House of Parliament of South Africa is situated in Cape Town while the seat of government is in Pretoria. Cape Town is known as the legislative capital of South Africa, while Pretoria is known as the administrative (executive) capital of South Africa and Bloemfontein is known as the judicial capital of South Africa. The upper and lower houses of the Parliament of South Africa are known as National Council of Provinces (90) and National Assembly (400) respectively. Thus, option (d) is the correct answer.

stem: Where is "Ground Zero"?
expl: After the terrorist attacks of 11 September 2001, the buildings of the World Trade Center complex in New York City (including the Twin Towers) collapsed. This destroyed site came to be known as “Ground Zero.” Ground Zero is the term applied to the location of twin towers in New York. A rebuilt World Trade Center complex has now been developed at this location.
